turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
day at 7:49 AM

Orders are normally shipped within 3 days after they are placed, and tracking is typically sent once the order has been fulfilled. For continental US orders, FedEx Ground usually takes 1 to 3 business days on the East Coast and 3 to 5 business days on the West Coast after shipment. FedEx 2-Day takes 2 business days after shipment, and Overnight takes 1 business day after shipment. Deliveries are Monday through Friday only.
